tips.text: Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy extra relics for the Zakti Prime Blueprint; it is the Rare part in every one.
Buy her relics from the Market's Prime Resurgence tab to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Refine the Rare relics to Radiant and leave Common-part relics Intact; Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Run a Radiant radshare for the Rares.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
